name: web-mcp
description: Semantic search over RSS/Atom feeds for AI agents. A single-file MCP server with recency-boosted TF-IDF ranking, trend extraction, markdown digests, and feed health monitoring — no API key, no cloud, and SSRF-guarded fetching. Ships with feed-curation and feed-digest skills plus pm, security-reviewer, and git-pipeline agents.

feeds.title: Starting feeds
feeds.description: Comma-separated RSS/Atom feed URLs to index on startup. You can add more later with the add_feed tool.
